cues: Osmosis is diffusion of a special kind.
A membrane separates pure water, on the left, from a sugar solution, on the right.
Water molecules are small enough to pass through it; the sugar molecules are not.
Such a membrane is selectively permeable.
text: Osmosis is diffusion of a special kind. A membrane separates pure water, on the left, from a sugar solution, on the right. Water molecules are small enough to pass through it; the sugar molecules are not. Such a membrane is selectively permeable.
